verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents reporting as part of the core plan ("build automations, segmentation and reports"), says performance data can be pulled via API to build dashboards and analyze marketing performance, and notes its MCP server can produce "flow performance reports." The evidence never names the specific metrics, per-step breakdowns, or time-series views. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of opens/clicks/unsubscribes/conversions metrics, per-campaign and per-flow-step breakdowns, over-time trend reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.
